name: City Council - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 23, 2015 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Proclamation declaring October 4, 2015 as Fire Prevention Week
4B.
Proclamation celebrating the 70th Anniversary of the Encinitas Fire Department
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 9/9/15 Regular Meeting and the 9/9/15 Closed Session. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2015-09-23 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2015-09-23 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Contract to perform geotechnical engineering services, geological services, civil engineering services, and construction inspection services. Contact Person: Deputy City Engineer Shields
Authorize the Director of Public Works, or his designee, to execute a contract with Geopacifica to perform geotechnical engineering services, geological services, civil engineering services, and construction inspection services for a two (2) year period with two (2) future options, each with the capability of extending the contract an additional two (2) years, at the discretion of the Director of Public Works.
2015-09-23 Item 8C - Professional Services Contract
8D.
Adoption of Resolution No. 2015-62 authorizing the City Manager, Finance Director and the Fire Chief to execute applications to the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services for obtaining certain federal financial assistance and/or state financial assistance in the event of a declared disaster. Contact Person: Management Analyst Jimenez
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2015-62 authorizing the City Manager, Finance Director and the Fire Chief to execute applications to the California Governor's Office of Emergency Services for obtaining certain federal financial assistance and/or state financial assistance in the event of a declared disaster; and, 2) Authorize staff to complete an updated resolution form (Cal OES 130) required by California Governor's Office of Emergency Services to be executed by the governing body of the jurisdiction requesting reimbursement.
2015-09-23 Item 8D - Resolution 2015-62 Authorizing staff for Cal OES applications
8E.
Agreement between the County of San Diego and the City of Encinitas for participation in the Regional California Identification Remote Access Network (Cal-ID). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Approve the agreement for participation in Cal-ID and direct the city manager to execute the agreement.
2015-09-23 Item 8E - Cal-ID Agreement
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Consider and approve options for the development of a public art ordinance to include a recommended funding strategy. Contact Person: Arts Administrator Gilliam
Approve options for the development of a public art ordinance with a recommended funding strategy, and bring back a draft ordinance for City Council consideration within 90 days.
2015-09-23 Item 10A - Public Art
10B.
Proposed Organically Managed Park Pilot Project at Glen Park. Contact Person: Park and Beach Superintendent La Riva
Approve the proposed Organically Managed Park Pilot Project at Glen Park.
2015-09-23 Item 10B - Organically Managed Park
10C.
Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas, Cardiff 101, and Healthy Day Partners for a "Fruit Grove" pilot project located at Glen Park. Contact Person: Park and Beach Superintendent La Riva
Approve a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas, Cardiff 101, and Healthy Day Partners for a Fruit Grove pilot project at Glen Park.
2015-09-23 Item 10C - MOU Glen Park
10D.
Proposed naming of Glen Park Fruit Grove. Contact Person: Management Analyst Roff
1) City Council to consider naming the Teresa Arballo Barth Fruit Grove at Glen Park; and, 2) If approved, adopt Resolution 2015-60 naming the Teresa Arballo Barth Fruit Grove at Glen Park.
2015-09-23 Item 10D - Naming of Glen Park Fruit Grove updated
10E.
The Pacific View 90% preliminary design report and letters of interest. Contact Person: Deputy City Engineer Shields
1) Accept Westberg+White, Inc.'s 90% draft Preliminary Design Report (PDR) for the rehabilitation of the Pacific View site (WF15A). Provide any direction as to desired modifications to the draft report for incorporation into the final draft; and, 2) Accept the Letters of Interest, provide direction regarding the most likely Operating Partner(s) and request a complete proposal based on the criteria listed in the solicitation for Letters of Interest.
2015-09-23 Item 10E - Pacific View PRD LOI
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
13.
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADDED BY COUNCIL MEMBERS
14.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
15.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS / PENDING FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
2015-09-23 Item 15 - City Council Follow Up Log
16.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
17.
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
